intervals.label: commissioning in the MINOS near-detector hall
intervals.note: "Spring 2009" (season precision, start month March); the first neutrino candidate was recorded on 27 May 2009 and the physics run began in September 2009.
intervals.quote: The ArgoNeuT detector was commissioned for the physics run in the MINOS-ND hall at Fermilab in spring 2009.

intervals.label: physics run in the NuMI low-energy beam
intervals.note: Month precision; the detector paper says the run lasted until late February 2010 and collected 1.335e20 protons on target.
intervals.quote: ArgoNeuT operated in the NuMI low-energy beam line directly upstream of the MINOS Near Detector from September 2009 to February 2010

intervals.label: completed
intervals.note: Terminal event: end of the physics run; no source consulted dates the removal of the detector.
intervals.quote: ArgoNeuT operated in the NuMI low-energy beam line directly upstream of the MINOS Near Detector from September 2009 to February 2010

name: ArgoNeuT detector
notes: Run statistics: "The first neutrino candidate was recorded on May 27, 2009."

placements.note: The existing Fermilab main-campus point (used for the MINOS near detector too) is reused; the MINOS-ND hall is about 100 m below ground and has no separate coordinate in the sources read.
placements.quote: ArgoNeuT was located just upstream of the MINOS Near Detector (MINOS-ND)

active_volume.quote: The active volume is 40 h × 47 w × 90 l cm3 , corresponding to about ∼170 liters of LAr.

drift_length.quote: the maximum drift length inside the TPC volume is `d = 47 cm

summary.plain: A tank of liquid argon, 170 litres in volume, with fine wire planes that record the tracks of charged particles from neutrino interactions in three dimensions.
summary.technical: Liquid-argon TPC with 47 cm horizontal drift, three wire planes (two instrumented, induction and collection), a cryostat with a cryocooler re-liquefaction and purification loop; muons exiting are ranged in the MINOS near detector.

technology.quote: The ArgoNeuT liquid argon time projection chamber has collected thousands of neutrino and antineutrino events during an extended run period in the NuMI beam-line at Fermilab.
technology.value: Liquid-argon time projection chamber with horizontal drift and wire-plane readout
